prompt: State the standard numerical value and unit for the acceleration of free fall near Earth's surface as specified for Cambridge International AS Level Physics (9702).
hints: Check the physical data sheet for Cambridge 9702.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Recall the standard value of g used in Cambridge 9702 syllabus.
Step 2: Write 9.81 with unit m s^-2.

mark_scheme.criterion: 9.81 m s^-2 (accept 9.81 N kg^-1; do not allow 9.8 or 10)
